163414.description:
Suzuki Souta, a high school boy on the school volleyball team, is interested in his classmate Shinonome Asahi, a member of the girls' volleyball team. She thought of him as a good volleyball player, so she has been seeking him out every day. Souta was a keen volleyball player until junior high. However, because of his height, he could never become the spiker he longed to be. As a result, he got into the habit of giving up on things. Souta's high school life: Will he meekly accept what he cannot have? Or will he try to become a man who can stand with Asahi? Youth is a series of choices. Please, Souta, hang in there and do your best!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

title.native: サキュバス系お姉ちゃんは見せたがり

163416.description:
Yoon Kwon struggles to survive his oppressive military service, where there is nothing but harsh physical training. One day, amidst a series of underwear disappearance incidents, the culprit turns out to be an exhibitionist who had secretly broken into the base… and she is a woman?!

“You stole them, right? Spread your legs before I report you to the commander!!”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

163418.description:
Tatari is a stray cat who was taken in by the siblings Takeru and Yuki. In a ramshackle apartment, they lived a poor but happy life. Until that day.

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

title.romaji: Ore no "Full Auto Buff" de Nakamatachi ga Sekai Saikyou: Soko ni Iru Dake Mujikaku Musou

163422.description:
Makoto, the second son, has long been looked down on by his brilliant older and younger brothers. One day, they see him getting along with a beautiful girl he happened to meet by chance—and are seized with jealousy.
With one girl at the center, an ugly rivalry between three brothers begins!!

(Source: Cycomics, translated)

title.romaji: Ore to Kyoudai no Renai Sensou

163423.description:
A popular manga artist's life is turned upside down by a young and beautiful female editor! A thriller depicting a forbidden relationship begins! Kyosuke Takasago is the writer behind the popular mangaka duo "Nankyo," who along with his wife, the artist Minami Takasago, are currently serializing a hit manga Typhoon Hitomi. He has a secret that he can never tell anyone in the world, let alone his wife. But of all people, his new editor knows his secret, and Kyosuke's brilliant life quickly crumbles with a bang...!

(Source: Magapoke, translated)

163424.description: On the day I was dumped by my uptight girlfriend Mishiro, my father suddenly remarried, turning Yuzuki — a gal who looks just like my ex — into my younger stepsister. My life is transformed by this little devil who does all the things my ex-girlfriend wouldn't do for me!
synonyms: The Yandere Stepsister Who Spoils Me Was My Ex-Girlfriend's Younger Sister

Second volume of the Nanae Sasaya Masterpiece Collection.

Included Stories:
1. Kattenishiyagare! (勝手にしやがれ！)
2. Makete Tamaru ka! (負けてたまるか！)
3. Minna Kutabare! (みんなくたばれ！)

5. Kogarashi ni Futari dake (木枯しにふたりだけ)

title.native: アイドルの推しおさめ

163430.description:
Transmigrating into the main character of your favorite book sounds like a dream come true, but knowing Viola Vellatoux grows to be disappointed in her ending, Arin Han sets out to rewrite the story. However, her adoptive family will not hesitate to assassinate one another in their fight for control. The new Viola needs to use her wits to convince everyone that she has what it takes while remaining true to her goal. Further complicating her schemes, the male lead looks eerily familiar and has a strange effect on her when she gets too close.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Played the Role of the Adopted Daughter Too Well
过分扮演了领养女儿的角色
ฉันเล่นบทลูกสาวบุญธรรมได้ดีเกินไปซะแล้ว

163431.description:
"Alice, I'm breaking off my engagement to you!" are the words Echs, the son of the Knight Commander, remembers from his previous life. In the very place where the prince's engagement is about to be broken off, he remembers the exact same situation from his previous life in a dating sim game. Though clearly fale, the villainess is blamed together with another character. And when he saw the heroine sneakily smiling at him, he made up his mind. He wants to save his favorite villainess and make her his own. This is just a sweet story about a hero reincarnated as the son of a knight commander in a dating sim game who dotes on the villainess.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Knight Commander's Son is Infatuated by the Villainess
title.native: 騎士団長の息子は悪役令嬢を溺愛する
title.romaji: Kishi Danchou no Musuko wa Akuyaku Reijou wo Dekiai suru

163432.description:
"Alice, our engagement is over!"

With that announcement by the prince, Ex, the son of the Knight Commander, suddenly recalls the memory of a past life. He remembers this exact same situation from an otome game he played in his previous life. The prince blames the villainess, even though she was clearly falsely accused. And when he saw the heroine smugly smiling at them, he made up his mind. He wants to save his favorite villainess and make her his own. This is a sweet story about a boy who is reincarnated as the son of the Knight Commander, who dotes on the villainess as one of the possible routes of an otome game.

(Source: Tugikuru, translated)

title.native: 騎士団長の息子は悪役令嬢を溺愛する
title.romaji: Kishi Danchou no Musuko wa Akuyaku Reijou wo Dekiai suru

163433.description:
My name is Lee Sera, and I somehow woke up in the body of the beautiful but despised public enemy of the empire, Igna Larkbella. To make matters worse, a letter just arrived demanding payment on an overwhelming amount of debt Igna acquired after ruining her family's 500-year-old business. It seems like I'm not going back home any time soon, so I need to set things straight if I'm going to survive here. It's time to make this villainess the most popular girl in the empire!

(Source: Tapas)

163434.description:
Amane hadn't seriously liked anyone since middle school. He learned how painful it was to be laughed at for sharing your feelings and had sworn off ever since. Now, he's just transferred to a new high school in Enoshima, where he meets Ryuuji, a boy in his class. Fast friends, the jaded Amane quickly warms up to the eager Ryuuji—but that warmth continues to grow into feelings much deeper than friendship. Follow the boys as they navigate a frustratingly authentic journey through high school romance.

(Source: Yen Press)

Notes:
- All chapters were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.
- Includes 58 extra chapters.

title.english: If It's You, I Might Try Falling in Love
title.native: 君となら恋をしてみても
title.romaji: Kimi to Nara Koi wo Shite Mite mo

163435.description:
Lucia, the first princess of the Kingdom of Faticia, meets Alicia, the daughter of a marquess, who laments that she never wants to be a villain's daughter. Lucia takes pity on Alicia for her future engagement to Lyle, Lucia's half-brother, leading Alicia to confide in Lucia that her engagement will be broken off and lead to her execution. To prevent the death of her father, the king, and an epidemic her brother starts, Lucia shift into action! A ten-year struggle that shapes the future of an NPC princess and a villainous daughter in a sim dating game begins!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: I'm Just the Incompetent Crown Prince's NPC Sister Princess, but I Sympathize with the Villain, So I'll Try to Help Her - No Princess Route?! Then Let's Create One!
title.native: ポンコツ王太子のモブ姉王女らしいけど、悪役令嬢が可哀想なので助けようと思います～王女ルートがない！？なら作ればいいのよ！～@COMIC
title.romaji: Ponkotsu Outaishi no Mob Ane Oujorashii kedo, Akuyaku Reijou ga Kawaisouna node Tasukeyou to Omoimasu, Oujo Route ga nai!? Nara Tsukureba Ii no yo! @COMIC

163439.description:
"Let's work together to prevent the future you fear, shall we?"

Eight-year-old "Mob Princess" Lutia made friends with "The Villainess" Alicia, who is scared of her fate, which she foresaw will end with her execution after her engagement is annulled. Lutia rescued the king, who was fated to die, with slime magic, in order to prevent future disasters. She also began mass cultivation of medicinal herbs to combat the coming plague, and the whole operation is going well, but then... an arson fire, which was not part of the original plot! It seems that his brother, the clumsy crown prince and the "seduction target", is involved behind the scenes.......

"Don't worry," Lugia said, "I won't let you become the 'villainess'! I'll protect my friend, my family, and my country from the bad-end! A little princess will fight fate to change the story's plot with the power of friendship and her own wits in this domestic politics fantasy!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title.native: ポンコツ王太子のモブ姉王女らしいけど、悪役令嬢が可哀想なので助けようと思います〜王女ルートがない！？なら作ればいいのよ！〜
title.romaji: Ponkotsu Outaishi no Mob Ane Oujorashii kedo, Akuyaku Reijou ga Kawaisouna node Tasukeyou to Omoimasu, Oujo Route ga nai!? Nara Tsukureba Ii no yo!

163440.description:
A complete gekiga adaptation of the book by Yo Tsumoto! The Shimazu Clan's Jigenryuu is the most powerful and respected style of swordsmanship in Japan. This is an authentic historical manga depicting the swordsman life of its founder, Togo Shigenori!

(Source: LEED, translated)

title.native: 白泉と墨染 階段下隠情事
title.romaji: Hakusen to Sumizome: Kaidan Shitagaku Jouji

163444.description:
It's well-known that living with one's mother-in-law is basically hell. So marrying a poor merchant with no family should be an easy way to avoid that mess, right? Well, that was Elaen's plan until she realizes that her husband, Ahen, lied to her, and is actually the son of the empire's ferocious Grand Wizard, Kanessis Corenea, who she'll have to live with at her palace! Though intimidated at first, Elaen realizes that Kanessis is nothing like the figures in mother-in-law horror stories, and becomes enamored with her charisma and unexpected kindness. If anything, the problem here is Ahen's ulterior motives for marrying Elaen, which she only discovered after the fact. But with Kanessis by her side, Elaen is ready to face any and all challenges in her marriage. Perhaps living with her mother-in-law was the best thing to ever happen to her after all!

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: อะไรของคุณแม่สามีคะเนี่ย?

163445.description:
Lehanne Copland led an ordinary life as a wife and a mother before a carriage accident cut her life short. In the next moment, she finds herself in the extraordinary situation of being 19 once more! Ecstatic at this second chance but reluctant to let go of her old life, Lehanne decides to do just one thing differently: confess to Schudermel Laft, her first love. But when she succeeds in asking him to be her partner for a party, Lehanne discovers he is not quite like what she had imagined...

(Source: Tapas)

163447.description:
Ruud Denatos' life of living in the shadow of his talented older brother Aesir, a genius dragon slayer, ends when Aesir is killed in a brutal battle. After the fight, a hidden dragon lord appears and sends Ruud to a past where Aesir doesn't exist! In order to find answers and his older brother, Ruud takes Aesir's place and wows the school with his skills and knowledge. But will Ruud continue to impress the academy, or will the lackluster skills of his past catch up to him?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: My Little Brother Is The Academy’s Hotshot
勇者の弟はアカデミーガチ勢
勇士弟弟超懂學院大小事

163448.description:
300 years ago, the invincible warrior Hyeon-Oh Kim brought down the Tower of the End, preventing the world’s demise. Though he should have died the moment the Tower of the End collapsed, Hyeon-Oh is reborn 300 years later in the body of a 17-year-old boy named Ju-Hyeok Kim. Meanwhile, he discovers the existence of the Constellations, who were once his disciples 300 years ago but were born during the time when he did not exist in this world. Will he be able to find them again and train them?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: 星座たちが俺の教え子
ลูกศิษย์ข้าเป็นกลุ่มดาว

163449.description:
After being frustrated with her husband for a while, Summer finally resolves the problem. But who's the person lying next to her?!

(Source: Toomics)
synonyms: 夫婦を堕とす淫らな罠

163450.description:
She came to the convenience store late at night and whispered to me when I told her I had a girlfriend:

"It's not a relationship, it's not love, it's just filling my loneliness for one night..."

163451.description:
Former best-seller author Kaiden meets his old crush Sonya in a bicycle crash. Where will fate lead them next?

(Source: Toomics)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.

163452.description: Suddenly all the women are jumping on me?! My virginity is also threatened at the police station, where a woman I encountered on the street one day jumped on me and ran for help. My place is said to have a mesmerizing scent...

163453.description:
Lee Seon-Ho was falsely accused of parricide crime for murdering his own father. He lived through each day without being able to die. One day, Seon-Ho was approached by a mysterious old man and offered a desired deal that he could never refuse…

(Source: Naver, translated)

163454.description:
After breaking up with his first love, Sean discovers that there's no one else for him but her. But turns out one of his brothers felt the same way.

(Source: Toomics)

163455.description:
I'm sick of the same dreary life and food every day. There has got to be more to life than this! Isu's life was never the same after his parents died, and he barely held on until one day, when a mysterious portal suddenly popped up in his apartment and sucked him into the fantasy village of Raudoren. With so many things to explore and most importantly, food that makes him drool, Isu starts to make himself at home.

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: I'll Resign and Have a Fresh Start in This World
I'm Going To Relax in This World After Submitting My Resignation

title.english: Resigning and Healing in Another World

163456.description: Yoo Beom is a genius college student who lost his family to an organization that manipulated cryptocurrency prices. Deciding to seek revenge, he hides his identity and infiltrates the cryptocurrency gangster organization, ‘ONE’. He uses his genius brain to begin a bloody revenge on the cryptocurrency organization that ruined his life.

163457.description:
The main character faces death while dealing with the ancestors who conspired with each other to get their hands on the sacred weapon, Sanhasajikdo.

Eun-I, the only sister left behind by Seo-Hyeon, the owner of a small household with no speculation that goes unrecognized. To protect his family, Seo-Hyeon concentrates on training Seoncheon's martial arts... Sanhasajikdo and Ki-Ryeong, which were thought to have disappeared, are restored and take a step toward the top again.
synonyms: Suseon Reincarnation Book: Return Of The Supreme

title.native: の方がずっと前から好きだったのに
title.romaji: No Hou ga Zutto Mae kara Suki Datta no Ni

163460.description:
Gathered here are five "murderers," but each has lost their memories. The young amnesiac girl Es is their warden, tasked with investigating their "sins." As the pasts of these murderers are slowly revealed, what "punishment" awaits them in the end? When you learn of their crimes, will you be able to forgive them?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: MILGRAM 実験監獄と看守の少女
title.romaji: MILGRAM: Jikken Kangoku to Kanshu no Shoujo

163461.description:
Han Juwon has the worst habit ever. He’s an average guy with an average college life, but his facial expression and words become terrifying the second he feels shy. Although he’s trying his best to fix it, Juwon realizes he messed up yet again when he says something rude to his hoobae, Jeong-min. And not only that, but he also keeps unintentionally touching Jeong-min’s chest every time they meet! Juwon knows he has to find a way to apologize to Jeong-min, but even while he feels guilty, he can’t stop thinking of what he accidentally discovered about Jeong-min’s chest… Turns out Juwon’s soft-hearted interior and gruff exterior aren’t the only things that are completely inverted…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapter.

まじめなパパには裏がある
title.romaji: Majime na Papa ni wa Ura ga aru

163465.description: Story of a estranged married couple who slowly reconcile their differences.

title.native: フォローミー、ゴースト

163467.description:
Forty-year-old detective Eiji Kirisame has found maybe the strangest witness of his life: a silent high school girl named Tsugumi Kuchinashi who was at the scene of the crime. Her statements mostly consist of shoddy doodles on a drawing pad, but Eiji is no stranger to piecing together the truth from limited evidence. He'll take every page seriously if it might help solve the case. But why does the last page say...

"Will you marry me?! "

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage

title.native: 人妻狩り 万屋テクから逃げられない

163469.description:
In a future where the world has been devastated by a deadly gas called Izpo, Min-Hui and his friends find themselves embroiled in a thick conspiracy — where the stakes are high, and bets are made with one’s life. Only the Memorial Chips guard humanity against the lethal gas that permeates the atmosphere. But are these electronic securities truly built to guard us — or watch us? Follow Min-Hui as he examines what reality is, and comes face-to-face with the truth that will change him forever.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

163470.description:
Lee Do-ri, a star satam instructor who lives an unmarried life due to the trauma of being abandoned by her birth mother in childhood, and Kim Mi-rae, a spiritual being who claims to be her future real daughter, comes to her, and she has to face a three-year refusal with her daughter whom she can only see. An impossible cohabitation begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

163471.description:
If you thought life on earth was hard, then try purgatory. What lengths would you go to fight for a life of guaranteed riches and success? These souls might have once forsaken their lives, but now, they’ll fight tooth and nail to return to life. Who will win the survival competition to gain the prize of being revived?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

163473.description:
The protagonist is in the middle of preparing for a presentation at a college seminar.

Ryousuke Kamiya, a college student, was browsing porn videos while taking a break when he stumbles upon a video featuring Yuuka Someya, a girl attending the same seminar! When he asks her about the video at a drinking party after the presentation, he finds himself being offered sex in exchange for not telling anybody about it...?!

(Source: DLsite, translated)
synonyms: A Story about How Someya-san, a Girl from My College Seminar, Turned out to Be an AV Actress.

title.native: 同じゼミの染谷さんがAV女優だった話。
title.romaji: Onaji Zemi no Someya-san ga AV Joyuu Datta Hanashi.

163474.description: Hoshiko, who loves astrology, is really delighted when she gets a first job at a renowned fortune teller office ! But her joy fades away quickly when she discovers the true nature of her work & boss...

163475.description:
Kaoru Maeda, 35 years old, is still an aspiring artist. He works as a janitor at an art college, where he is noted only for being a nice guy. He thinks that those who aren't natural geniuses must fight in a different way. What awaits him is "the biggest lie of his life!" Maeda is suddenly labeled as a "genius artist," because of a misunderstanding by a famous creator, even though he felt conflicted about it. He even begins to live together with a woman he met by chance… After 35 years, has the man with neither luck nor opportunity finally caught his big break…!?

(Source: Big Comic Bros, translated)

163476.description:
Chu Nan who is a top-class agent came to the city to cancel his engagement. Right as he hopped off the train he was dragged away and forced to pretend to be the boyfriend of a domineering CEO! I came to call of my engagement, why won't you let me go!"

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The School Beauty Is All Over Me

title.english: Campus Belle CEO Is Stuck On Me

163477.description:
The young girl Rosa has just lost her family and was in the depths of despair, when she driven out of her home and even robbed of her mother's belongings. Alvin, a handsome nobleman, is the only one who reaches out to help her. He gives Rosa a job, a place to stay, a blue dress fit for a lady, and more...

With the coming of the Industrial Revolution, the folktales about fairies are fading away. A lonely girl and a silver-haired gentleman find an irreplaceable love. This is a gentle fairy tale about the forgotten times.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 青薔薇アンティークの小公女

163478.description:
Rosa is a young girl who has lost her family and is on the edge of despair. Furthermore, she is driven out of her home and even robbed of her mother's belongings. Then, Alvin, a handsome nobleman, comes to her rescue. He takes Rosa in and gives her a job in his antique store, which features fairy and floral motifs. Supported by his status and wealth, and touched by his eccentric kindness, Rosa gradually regains her dignity, allowing her natural intelligence and beauty to shine. On the other hand, Alvin's strong interest in the fairies of folklore seems to hide a sorrowful past......? The mystery hidden in the folklore of the antiques will be the gospel that rescues two lonely souls.

(Source: Fujimi L Bunko, translated)

title.native: 青薔薇アンティークの小公女

163479.description:
Kairi's touch is soft and gentle. If this is a dream, Aya hopes she never wakes up...

Aya Okado is a 25-year-old saleswoman for a stationery company, but her high work performance comes at the cost of her personal life. On her way home from an exhausting day, she remembers her crush from her college days. While thinking about how cool he was, she's surprised to find a new, stylish cafe established near her house. She decides to check it out and finds her old crush working the counter...!! She's thrilled to reunite with him, but with how exhausted and drunk she is, he somehow ends up taking her home!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 如巧克力甜蜜柔滑的是他給我的美味獎賞

title.english: Eat Up! The Sweetest Chocolate Is Your Reward
title.native: ご褒美は甘く蕩けるショコラを召し上がれ
title.romaji: Gohoubi wa Amaku Torokeru Chocolate wo Meshiagare

title.native: 田舎お泊りの夜這いは、起こさず犯す。
title.romaji: Inaka Otomari no Yobai wa, Okosazu Okasu.

163481.description:
Malice, Unconsciousness, Urban Legends... The crossroads of music and the story of darkness corrupting people!!

Nagisa is a girl living in a fierce environment, both at home and school. Through music, she got addicted to the people on the internet. One day, she walked past a mysterious girl at the train station she usually goes to, and the world around her changed.

What she wandered into, is exactly the infamous 'Kisaragi Station', an urban tale popular among internet forums. As she fights against the monsters after her, what is the truth unraveling in front of her that makes her want to look away...?!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

163482.description:
When Shuichi was a child, he used to play with Yuu, a carefree boy who enjoyed exploring, roughhousing, and video games, and the two quickly became best friends. Now, ten years later, they’ve been reunited at an arranged marriage meeting, and it turns out that boy was actually a girl all along! What’s more, she’s become a beautiful young woman who wants him for a husband! It’s an awkward reunion, but can the two rekindle their friendship? And maybe let it become something more…?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

163748.description:
Taiwan during the Qing dynasty was deeply patriarchal. Women were disregarded from birth, their only purpose was to make a good marriage. But once married, the pressure was on to provide sons. This gave rise to various folk practices which were claimed to ensure male offspring. Chieh watches as her sister-in-law, obsessed with giving birth to a son, gives in to these superstitions. And she herself is under pressure to marry – can she ever break free?

Walking by the river one day, she comes across the body of a woman. A priestess is summoned to ensure her spirit passes peacefully and does not haunt the town. The woman, with her mysterious ways, does seem able to communicate with the spirit world and Chieh, seeing a glimmer of hope, enrolls as her apprentice. But soon after, small handprints start appearing on her legs as she sleeps, while more women go missing or are found dead. What will Chieh do, and will she find the life she wants?

A look at an independent young woman during the Qing dynasty, Guardienne is critical of the society of the time. Mixing folk tales and religion, it portrays the struggle of the women of the era living in a provincial city, and the beauty and tragedy of their lives.

(Source: Books From Taiwan)
